purpose: Public FiveM animation releases with creator links and server setup notes.

items.name: RPEmotes Reborn
items.author: alberttheprince and contributors
items.description: A standalone emote menu with built-in animations, shared emotes, props and support for custom animation lists.
requirements: Extract the release into a resource named rpemotes-reborn and add ensure rpemotes-reborn to server.cfg.
The maintainers require OneSync Infinity for synchronization and recommend the latest supported game build. Use oxmysql if you enable SQL features.

items.name: Hands in Pockets
items.author: BzZzi
items.description: A custom idle animation for roleplay scenes. The release supplies the dictionary and clip names.
items.requirementLabel: FiveM server · YCD animation · Emote integration
requirements: Use the archive attached to the author’s post and put the YCD in a resource’s stream folder.
Register dictionary bzzz@animations@hands and clip bz_hands in your emote resource. The author gives a DPEmotes example.

items.name: L&L Pose Animation Pack
items.author: L&L Shop
items.description: Five custom pose animations for screenshots and staged scenes.
requirements: Choose the free option on the creator’s store or use the attachment on the original release post.
Follow the included README and use the supplied animation list entries if your server runs DPEmotes.

items.name: Custom SP & MP Poses
items.author: crunchycat
items.description: A set of static character poses for arranging scenes in single-player or on a FiveM server.
items.requirementLabel: FiveM server · FiveM instructions in README
requirements: Follow the FiveM instructions in the included README.
Use the pack’s dictionary and clip names with your server’s animation resource and test the poses on the intended ped model.
